brier_identity: For the fixed equal mean of eight natural posterior vectors, average squared error minus mean-posterior squared error equals mean squared deviation about the mean, row by row. Verify the independent pair-distance identity in tests. This guarantees improvement over average individual Brier, not over the strongest expert and not in balanced accuracy.
hindsight_ceiling_scope: Realized labels choose a correct hard decision if any of these nine saved procedures has one. This is an unattainable hindsight selector statistic, not a prediction, Bayes accuracy bound, independent result, or proof that a causal gate can learn the selection. It is only an upper ceiling for choosing among this finite set of saved hard decisions on these same exposed rows.
metric_weights: Compute balanced masses as sum_i mask_i/(3*n_class(i)) within each asset/date, then average the six panels equally. Natural Brier uses equal row weights within each panel and the same equal panel average. Never subtract the two differently weighted quantities.

primary_sources.scope: Squared-error ambiguity decomposition; this diagnostic extends the elementary identity componentwise to three-class probabilities.
Historical cross-validated combination is a possible later research direction. No Super Learner is fitted, and its asymptotic guarantees are not assumed for these dependent rows.

purpose: Measure whether completed model errors contain complementary hard decisions and whether the exact Brier ambiguity reduction is material. No learned gate, weight fitting, probability change or model promotion is performed.
reporting: Report every expert, both assets, all dates, reference-rescue and reference-harm masses, pairwise disagreement, correct-expert-count distribution, unanimous errors, Brier identity and residual geometry. No selection on a displayed subset.
residual_matrix: Uncentered vector-residual Gram matrix and cosine under natural row weights. Undefined zero-residual cosine is null. These are not Pearson correlations.
selection_scope: Fixed eight representative completed learners plus the strongest retained complete reference. Existing marginal development scores were already known. This is not an unselected library or independent inference.
source_verification: Hash protocol inputs before reading results; verify all three completed source inventories transitively; require exact original row/label/clock alignment and reproduce original per-panel balanced accuracies within 1e-12.
